ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Federal Investigation into Missing or Dead Scientists
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the disappearance or death of at least 10 scientists and the federal investigation into these incidents.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and connections between entities involved
questions: What are the names and backgrounds of the missing or dead scientists?
Are there any connections between the scientists and their research?
ideas.insight: The investigation into missing or dead scientists raises concerns about potential foul play, research misconduct, or other malicious activities. Following the money and examining connections between entities involved could uncover a larger pattern.
